boundaries: Line 7994 (C19x's own `DOMContentLoaded` registration for `initCommentPopover`) is outside coverage; line 7995 (this scope's own text-tool section header) begins this scope, confirmed against C19x's own declared assigned_ranges end.

Line 8382 (the combined `window.isInPlaceTextEditing` gate) is the last line of this scope; line 8383 opens the next leaf's (C19z) `computeTextLayout` lead-in comment — confirmed by reading the frozen blob at 8379-8388: neither `computeTextLayout` nor `commitText` nor `splitTextIntoCharacters` appears anywhere in 7995-8382 by direct grep.
No lines inside 7995-8382 are excluded for another owner: every line belongs to exactly one of the four packets below, confirmed by the validator's packet-partition-equals-assigned-union check.

(a) Three popover entry modes and the module state each sets, all declared on ONE line (8010): `_textPendingPt`/`_textPendingBox`/`_textEditingRaster`, all initialized `null`. Point text: `openTextPopover(worldPt)` (8026-8031) sets `_textPendingPt=worldPt.clone()` (8027) and nulls the other two. Area text: `openTextPopoverForBox(topLeft,widthWorld)` (8036-8041) sets `_textPendingBox={topLeft:topLeft.clone(),width:widthWorld}` (8037) and nulls the other two. Re-edit: `openTextPopoverForEdit(raster)` (8045-8058) sets `_textEditingRaster=raster` (8046, nulling only `_textPendingPt`) and conditionally sets `_textPendingBox` from `raster.data.fixedWidth` (8053) — the ONE mode that does not unconditionally null `_textPendingBox`, because a re-edited AREA-text raster must re-populate the same fixedWidth box, not clear it. `commitText` (C19z, cited by name/line only — its own definition begins at timeline.js:8383+) is the ONLY consumer of these three fields (confirmed: no read of any of the three anywhere in this scope's OWN body outside their own setters/`closeTextPopover`). `closeTextPopover()` (8059, one line) is the only function that resets all three to `null` together — called four times, all from C19z (out of scope, see `reconciliation`), never from within this scope's own 388 lines.

(b) `positionTextPopover(worldPt)` (8011-8018) placement math: `v=view.projectToView(worldPt)` (8013, Paper.js world-to-screen); `#drawing-canvas`'s own `getBoundingClientRect()` (8014); `pop.style.left=Math.min(window.innerWidth-240,Math.max(4,cr.left+v.x+10))+'px'` (8016) — clamps the popover's own left edge to at least 4px from the viewport's own left edge and at most 240px from the viewport's own right edge (a hardcoded popover-width assumption); `pop.style.top` (8017) is the identical clamp shape with 220 in place of 240 (a hardcoded popover-height assumption) and a +10 offset in both axes from the clicked/dropped point. `resetTextPopoverFields(text,size,font,color,align)` (8019-8025) per-field defaults, each an `||` fallback on the DOM element's own `.value`: text→`''` (8020), size→`48` (8021), font→`'sans-serif'` (8022), align→`'left'` (8023), color→`color||state.strokeColor||'#000000'` (8024, a two-level fallback: the passed color, then the tool's own current stroke color, then black). `openTextPopoverForEdit`'s own `'vector:'+vectorFont` convention (8054): a vector-text root's `fontValue` is prefixed `'vector:'` before being written into `#text-font` so the popover (and, in C19z, `commitText`) can distinguish 'reopen as vector' from an ordinary raster font string by a simple string-prefix check — this scope itself never branches on that prefix, it only produces it.

(c) The vector in-place editor's full lifecycle in order, with lines: guard against stacking — `if(_inplaceTa)closeInPlaceTextEditor(true);` (8107, a same-line comment explicitly notes 'never stack two'). Glyph hiding by opacity, not `.visible` — `members.forEach(function(p){p.data.__inplacePrevOpacity=p.opacity;p.opacity=0;});` (8134), preceded by a 7-line comment (8125-8131) citing feedback #83 and stating the Rust engine's `buildSceneJson` never reads a Path's `.visible` flag (only layer-level visibility, per CLAUDE.md §5's `view.autoUpdate=false`) but DOES read `.opacity` — the SAME field used for a normal fade; the previous opacity is stashed per-glyph (not forced to 1 on restore) in case a glyph legitimately had non-1 opacity already. Anchor rule — `d.anchorTopLeft` (8112-8123 comment citing feedback #37 and #79; 8124 code: `var bounds=d.anchorTopLeft?new Rectangle(new Point(d.anchorTopLeft.x,d.anchorTopLeft.y),new Size(groupBounds.width,groupBounds.height)):groupBounds;`) — anchored at the STORED anchor point rather than the glyphs' own tight ink bounding box, because `buildVectorTextGroup` places `baselineY` at a nominal ascent approximation that only coincidentally matches ink bounds; using ink bounds instead drifts per-content and was the exact regression reported 2026-08-27. Textarea creation and style mirroring inside `reposition()` (8181-8243): `fontSize` from `d.size` (8206/8209), `fontWeight` `'700':'400'` from `d.bold` (8211), `fontStyle` `'italic':'normal'` from `d.italic` (8212), `textDecoration` built from `d.underline`/`d.strike` joined with a space (8213), `letterSpacing` from `d.letterSpacing` scaled by `view.zoom` (8214), `lineHeight` from `d.lineHeightMult||1.25` (8215), `textAlign` from `d.align||'left'` (8216). Resize handle and the `fixedHeight` write (8147-8180): a real DOM `<div>` pinned to the textarea's bottom-right corner (comment 8142-8146 explains why — the orange box is a Rust-rendered overlay with no hit-testing of its own); `pointerdown` (8152-8161) captures the CURRENT rendered size as the resize start (not an arbitrary default, so the box doesn't jump); `pointermove` (8162-8177) writes `d.fixedWidth` (8166) and, per the 2026-08-30 feedback #175 comment (8167-8173), `d.fixedHeight` (8175) — the first `d.fixedHeight` write introduced anywhere in this codebase per that comment's own account; `endResize`/`pointerup`/`pointercancel` (8178-8180) release pointer capture. `reposition()`'s Motion-aware projection (8181-8243): `SMMotion.layerMotionPointMap(state.activeLayerIdx)` (8201, feedback #131, 19-line comment 8182-8200 explaining the regression: a Motion-keyed layer renders transformed, but this editor used to project raw geometry) maps `bounds.topLeft` forward to `anchorWorld` (8202) before `view.projectToView` (8203); `window._inplaceTextBoxBounds` (8235-8239) is written in WORLD units (dividing the DOM px width/height back by `view.zoom`) using the SAME motion-mapped `anchorWorld`, explicitly because `buildTextDragBoxItems` (engine-bridge.js) does no Motion mapping of its own (comment 8230-8231). The three listeners (8245-8251): `input`→`reposition` (8245); `keydown`, `stopPropagation` always, `Escape`→`closeInPlaceTextEditor(true)` (8248), `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter`→`closeInPlaceTextEditor(false)` (8249); `blur`→`closeInPlaceTextEditor(false)` (8251). `closeInPlaceTextEditor(cancel)`'s decision table (8254-8288): guard `if(!ta)return;` (8256, already closed); remove handle+null all five module vars+clear `_inplaceTextBoxBounds`+`renderNow()` (8257-8260, unconditional, BEFORE reading `newText`); `discardNew` (8267, only used when `isNew`) permanently removes the hidden placeholder glyphs; `restore` (8268) reinstates each hidden glyph's stashed opacity; the combined bail condition (8269) — `cancel` OR no `root`/`root.data` OR empty `newText.trim()` OR (`!isNew` AND unchanged text) — routes to `discardNew()` (isNew) or `restore()`+`renderNow()` (re-edit) and returns, doing NO rebuild; past that guard, `layer=root.parent` vanished (8272-8273, 'layer vanished mid-edit... bail rather than build into nothing') routes to the same discard/restore branch; otherwise `pushUndo()` (8276, the ONLY undo-snapshot call in this whole span) precedes removing the old glyphs (8277) and calling `buildVectorTextGroup` (8279) — success sets `selectedPaths`, calls `saveActiveLayerFrame()`+`updateUI()`, `renderNow()` (8280-8282); failure logs a console warning, calls `showToast(SM.t('toastTextEditRebuildFailed'))`, and `restore()`s the ORIGINAL hidden glyphs (8283-8287, leaving the failed rebuild's own now-detached new content unreferenced — no explicit cleanup of a partial `buildVectorTextGroup` result is visible in this span).

(d) The raster editor's lifecycle (`openInPlaceRasterTextEditor`, 8303-8357; `closeInPlaceRasterTextEditor`, 8358-8377) and exactly what it does NOT do: it never rebuilds/re-bakes anything itself. `closeInPlaceRasterTextEditor` collects `newText` (8363), restores the raster's own opacity (8365), then — past its own early-return guards (`cancel`/removed/no-data at 8367; unchanged-or-empty text at 8368, 'nothing to re-bake') — sets `_textPendingPt=null;_textEditingRaster=raster;_textPendingBox=...` and calls `resetTextPopoverFields(newText,...)` (8372-8375) before calling `commitText()` (8376, C19z, cited by name/line only — its own `_textEditingRaster` branch performs the actual re-bake) — the lead-in comment (8298-8300) states this explicitly: 're-baked by the EXISTING writer... rather than a second copy of the bake, so the re-edit stays pixel-identical to the popover's' (CLAUDE.md §3). `openInPlaceRasterTextEditor` returns a boolean (`return false` at 8304 for a raster with no `.data`; `return true` at 8356 on successful open) — its ONE external caller, `onViewDoubleClick` (tools.js:8378, cited by line only), reads that boolean to decide whether to fall back to `openTextPopoverForEdit` on failure to open (tools.js:8379).

(e) The two-stage `window.isInPlaceTextEditing` definition: FIRST defined in packet 2 (8083) as `function(){return !!_inplaceTa;}` — true only while the VECTOR editor is open. Re-defined in packet 4 (8381-8382): `var _wasInPlaceTextEditing=window.isInPlaceTextEditing;` (8381, captures the FIRST definition by reference) then `window.isInPlaceTextEditing=function(){return !!_rasterInplaceTa||(_wasInPlaceTextEditing?_wasInPlaceTextEditing():false);};` (8382) — true while EITHER the raster OR the (wrapped) vector editor is open; the lead-in comment (8379-8380) states the reason explicitly: 'engine-bridge asks "is text being typed right now" and must not care which kind it is.' Its sole external reader is `buildTransformBoxItems` (engine-bridge.js:3037), which reads `window.isInPlaceTextEditing()` at line 3049 and returns `[]` (suppressing the Select tool's own transform gizmo) whenever either editor is open — confirmed by a whole-src grep restricted to `engine-bridge.js` (the one hit, 3049) plus a project-wide grep finding no OTHER external reader of the symbol.

(f) Every `SMEngineBridge.renderNow()` call in the span, all guarded `if(window.SMEngineBridge)`: 8242 (inside the vector editor's own `reposition()`, unconditional per-repaint call after every style mirror); 8260 (`closeInPlaceTextEditor`, unconditional, immediately after nulling all module state — fires on EVERY close including a no-op discard/restore); 8267 (inside `discardNew`, fires again if `isNew` discard is taken); 8269 (inside the combined bail branch's `else` half, fires again for a non-`isNew` restore); 8282 (inside the successful rebuild `.then()`, after `saveActiveLayerFrame`/`updateUI`); 8345 (inside the raster editor's own `reposition()`, same per-repaint shape as 8242); 8366 (`closeInPlaceRasterTextEditor`, unconditional, immediately after restoring the raster's own opacity).
